concerts.title: Sounds of the City
concerts.description: Presented by The RiverFront, Sounds of the City returns for its 5th annual performance, launching the One Community Culture Festival.

concerts.title: Falletta Conducts Gershwin & Strauss
concerts.description: Maestro JoAnn Falletta and pianist Joyce Yang get jazzy with Gershwin's Piano Concerto in F in this celebratory season opener.

concerts.title: Symphony of Sports
concerts.description: Symphony of Sports brings the excitement of the stadium to the Holland Center! A highly interactive family concert.

concerts.title: The Award-Winning Music of John Williams
concerts.description: Experience legendary film scores like never before in unforgettable performances of John Williams' most iconic music of the silver screen.

concerts.title: PetRock
concerts.description: Omaha's own '70s tribute band PetRock performs with your Omaha Symphony.

concerts.title: Handel's Water Music
concerts.description: The Omaha Symphony in collaboration with Saint Cecilia Cathedral proudly presents Symphony Cathedral Baroque: Handel's Water Music.

concerts.title: Bartok's Divertimento
concerts.description: The Symphony Joslyn series begins with a program showcasing triumphant 20th century pieces conducted by Lee Mills.

concerts.title: Tim Burton's The Nightmare Before Christmas
concerts.description: Pumpkin King Jack Skellington longs to spread the joy of Christmas, with the score performed live.

concerts.title: Dvorak's Seventh
concerts.description: Dvorak's exuberant Symphony No. 7 takes you on an epic adventure, led by Conductor Anna Rakitina and cellist Jaemin Han.

concerts.title: Carmina Burana
concerts.description: A 350-person choir joins the Omaha Symphony and professional soloists for Orff's groundbreaking and timeless Carmina Burana.

concerts.title: The Machine Performs Pink Floyd
concerts.description: The premier Pink Floyd experience comes to Omaha with classic hits and an immersive light show.

concerts.title: Schubert's Symphony No. 4
concerts.description: Schubert's Symphony No. 4 led by Maestro Jose Luis Gomez; Associate Principal Cello Gregory Clinton shines in Kabalevsky's Cello Concerto in G Minor.

concerts.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone in Concert
concerts.description: Relive the film for its 25th anniversary while a live orchestra performs John Williams' iconic score.

concerts.title: Physicians Mutual Omaha Symphony Christmas Celebration
concerts.description: Omaha's biggest annual holiday production, complete with Broadway singers and dancers.

concerts.title: A Festival of Christmas Brass
concerts.description: The Omaha Symphony in collaboration with Saint Cecilia Cathedral proudly presents A Festival of Christmas Brass!

concerts.title: Disney's The Muppet Christmas Carol in Concert
concerts.description: The complete film with the score performed live-to-picture.

concerts.title: Falletta & Mendelssohn's 'Italian'
concerts.description: Be transported to the Italian countryside in this dynamic program conducted by Maestro JoAnn Falletta.

concerts.title: Rachmaninoff's Symphonic Dances
concerts.description: Percussion propels this program from the dance clubs of Mexico to Rachmaninoff's frenzied Symphonic Dances.

concerts.title: Clouds in My Coffee: The Trailblazing Music of Joni Mitchell, Carole King, and Carly Simon
concerts.description: Songs by Joni Mitchell, Carole King and Carly Simon performed by Capathia Jenkins.

concerts.title: Adventure in the Deep, Dark Woods
concerts.description: The Gruffalo comes to life with narrator, orchestra and projected illustrations in this all-ages family concert.

concerts.title: Cody Fry
concerts.description: GRAMMY-nominated singer-songwriter Cody Fry brings his genre-bending, cinematic hit songs to the Omaha Symphony.

concerts.title: Mozart's Symphony No. 25
concerts.description: Mozart's 'Little' G Minor headlines a program led by Jonathan Taylor Rush. Principal Trumpet Scott Quackenbush soars in Gregson's Trumpet Concerto.

concerts.title: Mahler's Fourth
concerts.description: Mozart and Mahler's soprano-led masterpieces carry the audience through an evening full of opulent melodies.

concerts.title: The Wizard of Oz
concerts.description: The 1939 film classic returns to the big screen with the Omaha Symphony performing Herbert Stothart's score live to film.

concerts.title: Pink Martini
concerts.description: Pink Martini, the genre-blurring 'little orchestra,' returns with a blend of jazz, '40s-'50s pop and more.

concerts.title: Susanna Perry Gilmore Plays Mozart
concerts.description: Concertmaster Susanna Perry Gilmore shines in Mozart's intimate and elegant Violin Concerto No. 1.

concerts.title: Mermaids and Dragons
concerts.description: Featuring music from How to Train Your Dragon and Disney's The Little Mermaid.

concerts.title: The Doo Wop Project
concerts.description: A journey from the Crests and Belmonts through Smokey Robinson, The Temptations and The Four Seasons.

concerts.title: Stravinsky's Pulcinella
concerts.description: Stravinsky's mastery of neo-classical composition shines in his gorgeous Pulcinella suite for chamber orchestra.

concerts.title: 7 Bridges: The Ultimate Eagles Experience
concerts.description: 7 Bridges reimagines the Eagles' hit songs from the band's most prolific period.

concerts.title: Sibelius' Second
concerts.description: Sibelius' Second Symphony and Beethoven's Fourth Piano Concerto, led by Earl Lee with pianist Janice Carissa.

concerts.title: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back in Concert
concerts.description: The orchestra performs the award-winning John Williams score live with the film.

concerts.title: Beethoven & Haydn
concerts.description: Haydn and his reluctant protege Beethoven bookend this dramatic program led by conductor Katharina Wincor.

concerts.title: Applied Underwriters Presents Beethoven's Ninth
concerts.description: The season concludes with Beethoven's Ninth, ending with the epic Ode to Joy.

concerts.title: Issa Trap Symphony
concerts.description: Bars + beats + a professional string ensemble in a one-night-only genre-blending performance.

concerts.title: The RiverFront Fourth of July Celebration featuring the Omaha Symphony
concerts.description: A free, family-friendly evening in downtown Omaha at the Performance Pavilion.
